source.name: Destiny Data Compendium, Class Abilities (Empowering Rift), converted to stat 0
source.quote: Rift grants 20% [15%] increased damage, 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee, and 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate in a 5 meter radius.
source.note: Derived: 260 % × 0.4. Flat Gain has no row for the Rift; for Starfire Protocol, Heart of Inmost Light and Eye of Another World the Compendium text is 2.5 times the value at stat 0 (tests/energyStats.test.ts). The engine scales it with the stat (K4).
